Updated prompt: showcase_render_study

📜 **Version 2** saved (use `action:"history"` to view)

**Changes**: +3 additions, -3 deletions

```diff
===================================================================
--- a/development/showcase_render_study/prompt.yaml
+++ b/development/showcase_render_study/prompt.yaml
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 id: showcase_render_study
 name: Showcase Render Study
-description: "Render one shot's frame set through Remotion (default) or, when explicitly requested with tool:blender_render, through Blender, from the shot's key plates and timing chart (D72): the puppet holds and inbetweens between keys and never redraws; writes the stills, the consecutive-frame strip, the chart-conformance and identity probes, and the receipt skeleton."
+description: "Render one shot's frame set through Remotion (default) or, when explicitly requested with tool:blender_render, through Blender, from the shot's key plates and pose chart (D72, D83): the puppet holds and plays authored breakdowns between keys and never redraws; writes the stills, the consecutive-frame strip, the figure-only sequence and joints dump the inbetween probe reads, the identity probes, and the receipt skeleton."
 category: development
 userMessageTemplateFile: user-message.md
 arguments:
===================================================================
--- a/development/showcase_render_study/user-message.md
+++ b/development/showcase_render_study/user-message.md
@@ -4,6 +4,6 @@
 Previous handoff (key sheet):
 {{context | default("Read the key-sheet and motion steps from chain history.")}}
 
-Read the shot row in `v3/shots.json`, the chart `v3/charts/<shot>.json` and each actor's key plates under `assets/<actor>/keys/<shot>/` (a missing plate or chart is BLOCKED). Pose-to-pose (D72): the composition holds each key plate for its charted hold, places breakdowns at their favouring between consecutive keys (by registered joints when `K<n>.skeleton.yaml` exists, by the key plates' shared baseline otherwise), steps on twos, and draws nothing new; a shot that needs a pose no key supplies is sent back to the key sheet, never approximated by rotating parts. Remotion path: render at the frame set with `npx remotion still` / `npx remotion render --frames` on the pinned `swangle` renderer into `out/<shot>-f###.png` and `out/<shot>-strip.png` (consecutive frames tiled with ffmpeg); render the key frame twice and record both sha256 (C12); measure per-frame pixel change across the strip for the drawn and light regions (C16, C18) and against the chart: at each breakdown frame the displacement from the earlier key is its favouring ± 10 % (C23); overlay each key frame on the model sheet (C20); render the head at its on-screen size for the identity pass (D70); sample one pixel per identity pigment (C1). Blender path: only when `renderer` is blender AND the request names `tool:blender_render`; a refusal is BLOCKED, not a render. A single still cannot prove motion. Write `out/<shot>-probes.json` with every measurement and the receipt skeleton (Changed, Grades left empty, Controls, Owner, Next). Never describe a frame you did not open.
+Read the shot row in `v3/shots.json`, the chart `v3/charts/<shot>.json` and each actor's key plates under `assets/<actor>/keys/<shot>/` (a missing plate or chart is BLOCKED). Pose-to-pose (D72, D83): the composition plays the pose chart (`poseChartFrom` over `v3/poses/<shot>.json` and the registered key sheet; a missing pose sheet is BLOCKED, run animation_poses): each key plate held for its charted hold with its moving hold, every breakdown a pose (passing position on an arc, anticipation, overshoot, settle), secondaries lagging by their declared drawings, stepped on twos, drawing nothing new; a shot that needs a pose no key supplies is sent back to the key sheet, never approximated by rotating parts. Remotion path: render at the frame set with `npx remotion still` / `npx remotion render --frames` on the pinned `swangle` renderer into `out/<shot>-f###.png` and `out/<shot>-strip.png` (consecutive frames tiled with ffmpeg); render the key frame twice and record both sha256 (C12); measure per-frame pixel change across the strip for the drawn and light regions (C16, C18); render the figure-only layer as a png sequence to `out/<shot>-figure-seq/` (`--props='{"captions":false}'`), write the joints dump (`npm run joints -- <shot>`) and run `python3 scripts/animation/probe-inbetweens.py out/<shot>-figure-seq --joints out/<shot>-joints.json --poses v3/poses/<shot>.json` (C23, C32, C33: holds, one-sided arcs with monotone progress, eased spacing, overlap, moving holds; the gate runs the same probe over every pose sheet), quoting its control and summary lines; overlay each key frame on the model sheet (C20); render the head at its on-screen size for the identity pass (D70); sample one pixel per identity pigment (C1). Blender path: only when `renderer` is blender AND the request names `tool:blender_render`; a refusal is BLOCKED, not a render. A single still cannot prove motion. Write `out/<shot>-probes.json` with every measurement and the receipt skeleton (Changed, Grades left empty, Controls, Owner, Next). Never describe a frame you did not open.
 
-Return: Frames Rendered (path, sha256 prefix); Probes (determinism, twos/ones change %, chart conformance per breakdown, model-sheet overlay, identity samples, identity pass); Receipt Skeleton Path; Renderer Used; Concerns.
\ No newline at end of file
+Return: Frames Rendered (path, sha256 prefix); Probes (determinism, twos/ones change %, inbetween probe lines per check, model-sheet overlay, identity samples, identity pass); Receipt Skeleton Path; Renderer Used; Concerns.
\ No newline at end of file

```
